description: Submit one URL or a list of them to RSSAmp. A site URL works as well as a feed URL: the feed is discovered from the page. Anyone may submit; there is no account and no review queue. One URL resolves in the call and the answer carries its page; a list may be queued, and the answer says which. Rate limited per caller. Pass "email": we write once when the feeds are listed (or say why not). Not needed with an API key.

email.description: Where to send one note when the feeds are listed, or why they could not be. Required unless the call carries an API key.

urls.description: Feed or site URLs. One is fine.

name: submit_feed
title: Add a feed to RSSAmp
